title: When the Deadline Sings
author: Juniper Brightwater
blurb: Rosalind Yarrow, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
